title: Senior AI Product Manager
job_description:
**Job Purpose:**

As a Senior AI Product Manager, you will be the day-to-day strategic partner for forward deployed engineering (FDE) pods working on a set of high-impact engagements. This is an individual contributor role for someone who can take a complex business problem, structure it, size the value, prototype hands-on, and turn it into something a forward deployed engineer can build against.

You won’t manage engineers — you will be in the room with them, the business sponsor, and the data, translating between all three and keeping each engagement focused on the most valuable outcome.

Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. In this role, you will make sure the engineers we deploy are working on the right things by:

* Sizing value, structuring problems, building concept prototypes, and writing the business cases that fund engagements.
* Acting as the day-to-day strategic counterpart to FDE pods in active deployments.
* Bringing opportunity signals from business sponsors back into the portfolio.

**Responsibilities:**

  

**Opportunity identification and value sizing**

* Surface and size AI opportunities across your assigned engagements and adjacent business units, producing one-page opportunity briefs that are easy to compare and prioritise.
* Build credible value cases with finance-grade reasoning behind cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, or cost avoided.
* Develop hands-on domain knowledge of your engagement areas — workflows, data, decisions, and the people who own them.

**Strategic prioritisation and portfolio shaping**

* Recommend what to start, continue, and stop across your engagements based on evidence, not enthusiasm.
* Sequence work for impact, helping engineering leads decide what is in scope this sprint, what comes next, and what is out.

**Engineering partnership and enablement**

* Be the day-to-day strategic partner to FDE pods, converting business ambiguity into crisp problem statements, success metrics, and decision frameworks engineers can act on.
* Run engagement structure end-to-end — scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways — drafted, agreed, and revisited.
* Spot reusable patterns that should become platform capabilities instead of point solutions.

**Stakeholder alignment and communication**

* Work confidently with Director-level business and scientific stakeholders, running working sessions that move things forward and produce decisions, not just notes.
* Maintain sponsor confidence with concise updates, honest risk calls, and clear asks.

**Measurement, learning, and iteration**

* Track value realisation on each engagement against the business case written up front.
* Capture lessons rigorously and feed them back into how the team scopes the next engagement.

**Required Skills:**

* 15+ years of professional experience with bachelor’s or master’s degree or equivalent qualification.
* Candidates with the combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML products, product management, or strategy roles in technology-led organisations are preferred.
* A track record of taking complex, ambiguous business problems and turning them into structured, sized opportunities with defensible business cases.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one area of the pharma value chain (such as R&D, supply chain, or commercial), including how decisions actually get made on the ground.
* Technical fluency in modern AI/ML — enough to design realistic engagements with engineers and avoid hype-driven choices.
* Strong individual contributor instincts — you produce quality artefacts, not status updates.

**Preferred Skills**:

  

* Experience in Global Supply Chain (GSC), particularly Quality and Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT).

You won’t manage engineers — you will be in the room with them, the business sponsor, and the data, translating between all three and keeping each engagement focused on the most valuable outcome.

Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. In this role, you will make sure the engineers we deploy are working on the right things by:

* Acting as the day-to-day strategic counterpart to FDE pods in active deployments.
* Bringing opportunity signals from business sponsors back into the portfolio.

* Surface and size AI opportunities across your assigned engagements and adjacent business units, producing one-page opportunity briefs that are easy to compare and prioritise.
* Build credible value cases with finance-grade reasoning behind cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, or cost avoided.
* Develop hands-on domain knowledge of your engagement areas — workflows, data, decisions, and the people who own them.

**Strategic prioritisation and portfolio shaping**

* Recommend what to start, continue, and stop across your engagements based on evidence, not enthusiasm.
* Sequence work for impact, helping engineering leads decide what is in scope this sprint, what comes next, and what is out.

* Spot reusable patterns that should become platform capabilities instead of point solutions.

* Work confidently with Director-level business and scientific stakeholders, running working sessions that move things forward and produce decisions, not just notes.
* Maintain sponsor confidence with concise updates, honest risk calls, and clear asks.

job_description:
##### **Project description**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to lead complex digital capabilities across KYC/AML and Client Lifecycle Management (CLM). You will work at the intersection of business stakeholders, Vendor teams, Architects and Engineers, driving the product development journey from discovery to delivery through continuous improvement.
  
  
This is a hands-on Individual Contributor role for someone comfortable moving between stakeholder workshops, process design, wireframes, API specifications, user stories, and Agile engineering delivery.

##### **Responsibilities**

Own product capabilities end-to-end from discovery, strategy and roadmap through delivery, adoption and optimisation.

Translate complex KYC/AML and business problems into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes.

Build and prioritise the product backlog, balancing business value, regulatory needs, technology dependencies and technical debt.

Lead discovery workshops and create process flows, client/user journeys, wireframes and UI mock-ups.

Partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Operations, Product lead and business stakeholders.

Define requirements for REST APIs, including request/response behavior, JSON structures, data mapping, validation, errors and integration scenarios.

Drive Agile delivery through refinement, sprint planning, reviews and release planning.

Define appropriate non-functional requirements, including performance, availability, security, auditability, volumes and exception handling.

Use data and basic SQL to investigate issues, validate requirements and support product decisions.

Identify opportunities for automation, AI and Copilot to improve product delivery and operational efficiency.

##### **Skills**

Must have

At least 10 years of relevant experience, including strong hands-on Product Management/Product Ownership experience in complex enterprise environments.

Strong understanding of KYC/AML, Client Lifecycle Management, client onboarding, and periodic/event-driven KYC.

Proven experience delivering products using Agile/Scrum ways of working.

Excellent requirements, business-analysis and problem-solving skills.

Strong experience creating wireframes, UI mock-ups, user journeys, and process flows.

Good technical understanding of REST APIs, JSON and Swagger/OpenAPI specifications.

Working knowledge of SQL to perform data analysis.

Basic understanding of Azure/cloud, microservices, API gateways and event-driven integration concepts.

Excellent written and verbal communication with the ability to bridge business and technology.

Confident working independently, influencing without authority and constructively challenging assumptions.

Proactive, positive and ownership-driven attitude, comfortable operating in ambiguity.

Effective use of Microsoft Copilot for requirements elicitation, documentation and productivity improvement.

Nice to have

Intelligent Document Processing, document management platform.

Experience with KYC/AML, handling external data providers.

Knowledge of Kafka/webhooks, asynchronous processing, Postman, GitLab/Jira/Confluence, data lineage and observability.

Experience with legal-entity/reference data, company registries, data reconciliation and multi-jurisdiction regulatory requirements.

##### **Other**

Languages

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

Seniority

Senior

  

Pune, India

Req. VR-126104

title: Senior Product Manager I
job_description:
About Us:

Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.

Overview:

Learning is where that mission gets personal. Our vision is Connected Learning: training, practice, and coaching that are always-on and tailored to each rep, grounded in what's actually happening in their deals. Because learning shares context with a rep's accounts, meetings, approved content, and skills, we can deliver what they need next, in the moment they need it, and show whether it moved the number.

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll lead key parts of two of our strategic themes: Adaptive Training, which removes the manual work for enablement teams and gives every rep only what they still need, and Continuous Learning, which brings learning into the flow of work so it sticks. You'll partner closely with others PMs on the team.

At Seismic, PMs operate as the general managers of their areas. You won't be handed a backlog of feature requests. You'll decide where the most valuable, durable opportunities are, place the bets, and own the results: adoption, expansion, retention, and revenue. This is a role for a PM who wants to run a business, not maintain a feature list.

Who you are::

* **5+ years of product management experience** building user-facing products (B2B or B2C). You're fluent in discovery, specs, prioritization, and launch, and you don't need training on the fundamentals.
* **An AI-forward way of working**. You use AI every day to work faster and better, whether that's synthesizing research, prototyping, drafting specs, or analyzing data, and you can share specific recent examples.
* **A business owner's mindset**. You think in terms of outcomes, unit economics, and durable value, define clear success metrics, read the data, and change course when the evidence says so.
* **Technical fluency**. You can have credible conversations with engineers about LLMs, agent harness, data, and design tradeoffs.
* **A strong point of view**, held with humility. You can turn ambiguity into a clear plan and bring engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success along with you.
* Comfort working with distributed teams across time zones, including occasional early or late meetings.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

**Bonus points**

* You've shipped AI products, such as agents, copilots, or AI-powered features, and know what it takes to make them reliable.
* You've built learning products, in corporate learning, sales enablement and readiness, edtech, or consumer learning.
* You're curious about how people learn: spaced reinforcement, mastery learning, coaching, and practice.
* A category being rewritten. AI is changing how sellers learn and how enablement teams work, and you'll help define what comes next.
* Ownership that's real. You'll run a meaningful area of the business, with the accountability and the room to match.
* Real scale from day one. Your work will reach enablement teams and sellers at some of the world's best-known brands.
* A team that builds with AI, not just for it. We use agentic tools in our own work and expect you to as well.

What you'll be doing::

* Run your areas like a business. Set the strategy and roadmap, choose the bets that create the most durable value, help shape how they're packaged and priced, and own the adoption, retention, and revenue outcomes that follow.
* Create best-in-class agentic training authoring and training management, so enablement teams turn the content they already trust into training in minutes and agents handle the busywork of assigning, tracking, and following up, whether teams work in Seismic or in the AI tools they already use.
* Make training adapt to every rep, so reps skip what they've already mastered and spend their time on what they still need.
* Bring learning into the flow of work with just-in-time micro-learning, instant answers grounded in training, and peer examples from top performers' real calls.
* Connect learning to performance. Use deal, meeting, and skill signals to decide what each rep needs next, and define how we prove impact beyond course completions.
* Stay close to customers. Talk with enablement leaders, sellers, and managers every week, run discovery with design and research, and bring a sharp point of view back to the team.
* Ship with engineering in fast, measurable increments, including the evals and quality bar that make AI features trustworthy.

Job Posting Footer:

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.

**Company:** iFieldSmart Technologies LLC

**Position:** Product Manager

**Experience:** Experienced professional with a B2B SaaS background

**1. Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced, proactive, and execution-oriented Product Manager who will act as a central coordination point between the Sales, Marketing, Product Coordination, and Product Development functions.

The primary responsibility of this role is to take end-to-end ownership of product delivery commitments made to clients by the Sales team and ensure that products currently under development are completed, made market-ready, and successfully handed over to the Marketing team for launch.

The individual will work closely with our existing Product Coordinators, Project Managers, and Program Managers, who are responsible for managing individual products and development programs and coordinating with engineering management and development teams.

The new Product Manager will oversee and coordinate across these program owners, track overall progress, ensure alignment on priorities and deadlines, proactively identify bottlenecks, and take ownership of ensuring that business commitments are fulfilled.

This is a highly coordination-driven and ownership-oriented role requiring someone who can manage multiple priorities, work with cross-functional teams, proactively identify challenges, and drive timely execution.

**2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Client-Specific Product Delivery Management**

· Take complete ownership of product delivery commitments made by the Sales team to different clients.

· Coordinate with the respective Product Coordinators, Project Managers, and Program Managers responsible for the development of those products or features.

· Ensure that client-specific requirements, priorities, and committed delivery timelines are clearly communicated to the respective program owners.

· Maintain proactive tracking of multiple ongoing client deliveries, milestones, dependencies, and deadlines across different programs.

· Regularly follow up with the respective coordinators and program managers to understand development progress and identify potential delays or roadblocks.

· Proactively identify risks, resolve coordination bottlenecks, and escalate critical issues to senior management whenever required.

· Maintain clear communication and alignment between Sales, Marketing, and Product/Program Management teams regarding delivery status, changes, and expectations.

· Ensure that client commitments are not just tracked but successfully fulfilled, taking full accountability for overall delivery outcomes.

**B. Product Completion & Market Launch Management**

· Take ownership of existing products and features that are in the development or finalization stage.

· Work closely with the respective Product Coordinators and Program Managers to ensure pending development activities are completed.

· Track product readiness, identify gaps, and drive closure of pending requirements before launch.

· Coordinate with the concerned program owners to ensure product testing, quality checks, and final readiness activities are completed.

· Ensure completed products and features are properly documented and handed over to the Marketing team.

· Work closely with Marketing to communicate product capabilities, features, use cases, and launch requirements.

· Ensure products are ready for marketing campaigns, customer demonstrations, and commercial rollout.

· Track the overall product launch pipeline and ensure products do not remain indefinitely in the development or finalization stage.

**C. Cross-Functional Coordination & Stakeholder Management**

· Act as the central coordination point between Sales, Marketing, and the existing Product Coordination / Program Management teams.

· Work closely with multiple Product Coordinators, Project Managers, and Program Managers, each responsible for managing different products or development programs.

· Maintain visibility into the progress of all ongoing product development initiatives and client-specific commitments.

· Ensure business priorities, client requirements, and deadlines are aligned with the respective program owners.

· Conduct regular follow-ups and status reviews to ensure timely execution.

· Proactively identify dependencies, delays, resource constraints, and risks that could impact product delivery.

· Coordinate with the relevant program owners to resolve bottlenecks and escalate critical issues to senior management, engineering management, or the CEO whenever necessary.

· Keep senior management informed about delivery progress, critical dependencies, risks, and challenges.

· Ensure smooth information flow between technical and non-technical teams.

**Important clarification about the role:** The Product Manager will primarily coordinate with the existing Product Coordinators, Project Managers, and Program Managers rather than directly managing developers or assigning day-to-day technical development tasks. The respective program owners will continue to manage development execution through engineering management and development teams. However, the new Product Manager will be accountable for tracking and driving overall delivery outcomes.

**3. Candidate Profile & Required Experience**

We are specifically looking for someone with:

· Experience working in a B2B SaaS product company.

· Exposure to international markets and experience working with international clients or customers, preferably the US market.

· Previous experience working in a startup or fast-growing technology company.

· Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, particularly Sales, Product, Program Management, and Engineering functions.

· Experience in product delivery management, program coordination, product operations, or product management.

· Strong project execution, delivery management, and stakeholder management capabilities.

· Ability to manage multiple projects, client commitments, products, and deadlines simultaneously.

· Experience tracking deliverables through multiple project or program owners.

· A proactive approach to identifying problems, following up, and ensuring things get completed.

**4. Preferred Mindset & Additional Requirements**

· Flexible and adaptable to a fast-paced startup environment.

· Willingness to multitask and take ownership beyond narrowly defined responsibilities.

· Strong execution-oriented mindset rather than just planning and reporting.

· Ability and willingness to learn the technical aspects of AI-powered products and solutions.

· Willingness to understand the construction technology industry and its workflows.

· Good communication, coordination, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

· Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

· Ability to work independently, drive accountability, and ensure follow-through without requiring constant supervision.

**5. What We Are Looking For**

The ideal candidate should be able to ensure that:

1. Whatever Sales commits to clients gets delivered within the agreed timelines.

2. All existing Product Coordinators and Program Managers are aligned with business priorities and client delivery commitments.

3. The overall progress of multiple products and development programs is proactively tracked.

4. Potential delivery issues, dependencies, and bottlenecks are identified and addressed before they become major problems.

5. Senior management has clear visibility into product delivery progress and potential risks.

6. Products nearing completion are driven towards launch readiness.

7. Marketing receives completed, properly documented products and features for successful market launches.

8. There is clear coordination and accountability between all business and product-related teams.

**The ideal candidate is an execution-focused Product Manager who can connect business commitments with internal product execution, coordinate multiple program owners, and take complete ownership of getting things delivered.**

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
title: Principal Product Manager
job_description:
**Powering the agentic revolution in travel.** Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

Job Description- Principal Product Manager

**1. Role Overview**  
The Principal Product Manager for Corporate Intelligence will lead the product strategy and evolution of PRISM, Sabre’s corporate travel intelligence and decision-support platform. The role sits at the intersection of airline corporate sales, travel data, analytics, contracting, APIs and AI, and requires a strong understanding of how airlines use corporate travel data to make commercial decisions. This leader will own the evolution of the portfolio from traditional reporting and analytics toward predictive and prescriptive intelligence, helping airline customers improve corporate sales performance, contract effectiveness, market share and return on invested discounts. The role requires senior-level product leadership to connect customer and market needs with technology, data and commercial strategy

**2. What THIS ROLE Will Do**  

* Define and drive the Corporate Intelligence product vision, strategy, investment priorities and multi-year roadmap, balancing customer commitments, platform modernization, competitive differentiation, revenue protection and new growth opportunities.

* Drive capabilities that will transform the product to predictive and prescriptive intelligence, including contract optimization, forecasting, scenario modeling, AI-assisted insights and intelligent recommendations.

* Partner directly with airline corporate sales, commercial and revenue teams to understand complex problems around corporate contracting, market share, account performance, discount effectiveness and revenue opportunities, then translate those needs into scalable product capabilities.

* Shape capabilities across data ingestion, data quality, APIs, analytics and integrations, including agency/TMC connectivity, NDC and direct channels, CRM integrations and the modernization of customer access to Corporate Intelligence data.

* Partner with Engineering, Data Science, AI, Commercial, Customer Care, Delivery and Data Governance teams to take capabilities from strategy through delivery and adoption. Support strategic customer engagements, renewals, RFPs and new-business opportunities while ensuring the roadmap remains scalable rather than customer-specific.

**3. What THIS ROLE Requires**

* 10+ years of relevant product, travel technology, airline commercial, data or analytics experience, including demonstrated ownership of complex B2B or enterprise software products. Experience operating at Principal Product Manager or equivalent strategic product-leadership level is strongly preferred.

* Deep airline and corporate travel domain knowledge, with a strong understanding of corporate sales and contracting, TMC/agency ecosystems, airline distribution, GDS/NDC/direct channels, ticketed travel data, O&D concepts, market share, corporate account performance and commercial analytics.

* Strong data and technical product acumen, with the ability to work effectively with APIs, data pipelines, cloud/data platforms, data-quality concepts, analytics, CRM integrations and large-scale transactional datasets. The candidate does not need to be an engineer, but must be capable of translating business problems into technically credible product requirements and architecture discussions.

* Advanced analytics and AI product understanding, including predictive analytics, optimization, machine learning and Generative AI. The role must be able to identify where AI can materially improve airline commercial decision-making while ensuring data quality, explainability, governance and human oversight.

* Strategic and commercial product leadership, with demonstrated experience developing product strategy, prioritizing roadmaps and investments, building business cases, supporting enterprise customers and RFPs, and aligning senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Commercial and customer organizations.

**4. Why Join Us**  
The role combines strategic product leadership with direct customer and commercial impact. You will work across Product, Engineering, Data Science, AI and Commercial teams and engage with airline customers. This is an opportunity to influence the broader evolution of Sabre’s Corporate Intelligence portfolio and how trusted data and AI are converted into measurable customer and business outcomes.

We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as your application progresses.

Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role will proceed in the selection process.

title: Technical Product Manager - AI Platforms, Director
job_description:
Closing date for applications: 04/12/2026

Location Bangalore, India

Job typePermanent | Contract typeFull Time

#R-00288180

  

**Join our digital revolution in NatWest Digital X**
----------------------------------------------------

In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.

So we organise ourselves around three principles: engineer, protect, and operate. We engineer simple solutions, we protect our customers, and we operate smarter.

**Job description**
-------------------

This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.

Join us as a Technical Product Manager - AI Platform

  
  

* You’ll be responsible for managing the development and implementation of technology-driven products
* The role focuses on understanding customer needs, overseeing the product lifecycle, and collaborating with technical and non-technical teams to ensure successful product delivery that aligns with business objectives
* You’ll gain valuable senior stakeholder exposure as well as the opportunity to hone your technical talents and leadership skills
* We're offering this role at director level
  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  

We’ll look to you to drive the end-to-end lifecycle of technology products, from roadmap ownership and feature prioritization to launch and post-release evaluation. You’ll ensure strategic alignment through clear documentation and effective stakeholder communication, while proactively managing risks and fostering cross-functional collaboration.

  
  

You’ll also provide technical guidance to engineering teams, articulate customer pain points, and define performance metrics to measure success. We’ll also look to you to lead and mentor team members, supporting hiring efforts, and enabling agile decision-making to maintain momentum and
  
deliver impactful, customer-centric solutions.

  
  

Additionally, you’ll be:

  
  

* Delivering a product roadmap that aligns with business objectives and technological advancements
* Ensuring effective communication between technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Leading the product development lifecycle from concept to delivery with a high-performing engineering team
* Making data-driven decisions that improve product performance and user satisfaction
* Providing regular reporting on product performance, development progress, and market trends
  

  

**The skills you'll need**
--------------------------

  
  

We’re on the lookout for a strategic thinker with a passion for technology and innovation. You’ll have extensive experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field with strong leadership abilities, capable of motivating and influencing cross-functional teams.You’ll need at least seventeen years of total experience, with strong expertise in setting product vision, defining product strategy and roadmaps, and aligning development with strategic outcomes.

  
  

You’ll bring extensive experience in designing large-scale cloud architectures and distributed systems across AWS, GCP, and Azure, along with deep expertise in GenAI platform architecture, agentic systems, cloud-native technologies, and hands-on platform engineering. You’ll also be experienced in creating financial forecasts for products and features, contributing to platform-level budgeting, and driving focus and efficiency through disciplined prioritisation and agile decision-making.

  
  

You’ll also have:

  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Proficiency in project management tools and Agile or Scrum methodologies
* Familiarity with software development processes and technologies
* The ability to work in a fast-paced environment

**Welcome to our Bangalore hub**
--------------------------------

Located at Taurus 4, Bagmane Constellation Business Park, our new office stands as a state-of-the-art hub for innovation and collaboration.

### **Key facts:**

* A 30 acre campus
* Space for 6,000 colleagues
* Opened in 2025

title: Sr Staff Technical Product Manager
job_description:
The Analytics & AI Delivery Manager for Sourcing is responsible for defining, owning, and executing the end-to-end data, analytics, and AI product delivery for Power’s Sourcing organization. This leadership role ensures that analytical and AI products are delivered on time, within budget, and to high-quality standards while generating measurable business value.
  
  
Serving as a strategic bridge across executive business stakeholders, Digital Technology, analytics operations, AI Foundry, Power teams, the leader will establish the product vision, define complex business and technical requirements, and translate business priorities into scalable, user-centric Analytics and AI solutions. The role will orchestrate cross-functional delivery, drive adoption and integration into day-to-day operations, and continuously improve product performance across the Sourcing domain.
  
  
As the AI Delivery Leader, this individual will oversee overall AI product delivery—from data readiness assessments and Proof-of-Concept execution through MVP delivery, production deployment, and operational transition. By combining deep business-process understanding with strategic roadmap ownership and disciplined delivery oversight, the leader will ensure that data and AI investments remain aligned with operational priorities, customer needs, and evolving market opportunities.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

In this role, you will:

* **AI Data Readiness and Delivery**: Partner with the AI Strategy Data Science and AI Architecture teams to lead data-readiness activities, technical execution of proofs of concept, MVP development, and the scaling of validated solutions into high-impact, production-grade AI products.

* **AI Strategy and Demand Management:** Partner with the AI Strategy Portfolio team to build and maintain a strong demand pipeline, establish effective intake and prioritization processes, and enable a stable, scalable AI delivery model.

* **Data and Analytics Strategy and Lifecycle Ownership**: Partner with Data Architects to define and execute the end-to-end roadmap for data, analytics, and AI products—from ideation and proof of concept through MVP delivery, production deployment, and ongoing product optimization.

* **Partner and Capacity Management:** Translate demand and priorities from the agile planning process into actionable capacity plans. Lead the Program Increment planning process and work with OCIO and strategic partners to onboard the right resources and capabilities for both analytics and AI delivery.

* **Cross-Functional Leadership**: Serve as the primary liaison among executive stakeholders, Digital Technology, business operations, and delivery partners to align requirements, priorities, and execution with strategic business objectives.

* **Operational Excellence:** Drive simplification, standardization, and delivery rigor by facilitating workshops and implementing improvements across tools, processes, and workflows.

* **Requirements and Backlog Management**: Translate complex business needs into well-defined features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized product backlogs using agile or hybrid delivery methodologies.

* **Data, Risk, and Compliance Governance**: Ensure that all analytics and AI solutions comply with enterprise standards for data quality, architecture, cybersecurity, internal controls, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

* **Standard Work and Platform Optimization**: Establish robust standard work, simplify complex delivery processes, and continuously optimize analytical platforms and operating models for scalability, reliability, and performance.

* **Performance Monitoring and Value Realization**: Define product KPIs, monitor adoption and user feedback, identify performance trends, and drive continuous product enhancements that deliver measurable business outcomes.

* **Automation and Productivity**: Identify opportunities to automate manual activities, improve end-to-end process and data lineage, and partner with enterprise data organizations to increase delivery efficiency and overall team productivity.

  
  

**Qualification**

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, or a STEM-related field, including Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics.

Experience in data management, business intelligence, data analytics, or related discipline.

Technical experience, with demonstrated leadership across multiple functions and disciplines within a product or delivery organization.

Demonstrated success leading at least two significant transformation initiatives, including organizational change management and the delivery of measurable business outcomes.

  

**Desired Characteristics**

  

* **Technical Proficiency:** Demonstrated experience working in Agile and SAFe environments, with strong knowledge of enterprise data and analytics technologies such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, SAP, Oracle, and Databricks. Familiarity with cloud, big data, and AI/ML technologies, including AWS, Python, Spark, and Java, is highly desirable.

* **Business and Domain Expertise:** Strong understanding of Sourcing value streams and the integration of transactional and analytical data to enable actionable insights and measurable business value.

* **AI and Analytics Strategy**: Solid knowledge of data governance, master data management, and the end-to-end AI and machine learning lifecycle, including data readiness, proof-of-concept execution, MVP development, production deployment, and ongoing optimization.

* **Strategic Leadership:** Proven ability to lead transformation, navigate competing priorities, influence senior stakeholders, and translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-technical business leaders.

* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Demonstrated ability to build inclusive, high-performing teams and collaborate effectively across Digital Technology, Sourcing and other functional organizations to align product strategy with operational priorities.

* **Governance and Risk Management:** Strong commitment to enterprise standards and controls, including cybersecurity, SOX compliance, data governance, privacy, application controls, and regulatory requirements.

* **Process Improvement:** Experience applying Lean principles, structured problem-solving, and continuous-improvement methodologies to simplify processes, establish standard work, and improve the scalability and performance of the product portfolio.

* **Influential Communication:** Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to mentor and energize teams, establish a shared vision, build alignment, and maintain momentum through complex technical and organizational challenges.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

title: Digital Channels Cash Product Lead
job_description:
Requisition Number: 64952

Job Location: Bangalore, IND

Global Grade: Band 5

Work Type: Office Working

Employment Type: Permanent

Posting Start Date: 18/11/2026

Posting End Date: 12/12/2026

:

**Job Summary**
---------------

* Own the Cash product agenda across the Digital channels, with strategic accountability for translating Cash and Payments priorities into scalable capabilities across Host-to-Host (H2H), SWIFT and Common Channel Services (CCS).

• Lead the development, prioritisation and commercialisation of channel capabilities and features, ensuring investment is anchored in clear client use cases, measurable commercial value, regulatory needs and end-to-end client outcomes.
  
• Lead and develop a team of Product Owners to convert strategy into an executable global roadmap and deliver consistent, secure and reusable Cash Digital capabilities across markets, client segments and connectivity models.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy, portfolio and business partnership**  
• Own the global Cash channel strategy and roadmap across Web, H2H, SWIFT and CCS, aligning country, regional and global demand to business priorities.
  
• Act as the senior Channels counterpart to Cash Product heads and represent the portfolio in senior governance, investment and prioritisation forums.
  
• Partner with global, regional and country Cash Product heads to understand business, client and product priorities in every market.
  
• Manage senior stakeholders across global product and country management, Channels and Technology, setting expectations on scope, timing and trade-offs. Make transparent trade-offs across growth, client commitments, regulatory or scheme deadlines, resilience, simplification and platform modernisation.
  
**Product execution and prioritisation**  
• Own the global Cash backlog for Channels and rank demand using commercial value, client impact, regulatory urgency, risk, effort and delivery feasibility.
  
• Lead the working relationship between Cash, country, Channel Product and Technology teams to agree scope, dependencies, release plans and accountable outcomes.
  
• Run one intake process for all demand, sorting each request, assess client requests tied to mandates /RFPs and implementation deadlines, track regulatory requirements against deadlines.
  
• Apply a clear prioritisation framework, ringfence capacity across regulatory, client driven scope on revenue and client priority, and sequence delivery. Spot common needs across markets to deliver them as global capabilities.
  
• Maintain executive oversight of multiple initiatives running in parallel across markets, products and channels, keep a portfolio view of status, risks, milestones and cross-channel dependencies, intervening early where delivery or value is at risk.
  
**Client insight, proposition and commercialisation**  
• Build evidence-based country and client use cases covering target segments, revenue and volumes at stake, adoption barriers, competitive gaps and the cost of not acting.
  
• Define differentiated value propositions and commercialisation plans for new capabilities, partnering with Sales, Implementation, Onboarding and Client Service to drive launch readiness and adoption.
  
• Track adoption, transaction volumes, client feedback and realised benefits after launch, using insights to refine the proposition and roadmap.

**Cross-channel capability and solution leadership**  
**• Translate Cash and Payments needs into end-to-end capabilities spanning digital journeys, entitlements, approvals, connectivity, formats, payment status and reporting.**  
**• Guide solutioning across H2H connectivity (SFTP, AS2 and HTTPS), SWIFT channels (FileAct, FIN and gpi), ISO 20022 messages and legacy or local clearing formats.**  
**• Promote reusable components, standard formats and common services while safeguarding security, resilience, sanctions, fraud, accessibility and regulatory requirements.**  
**People and talent**  
**• Lead, coach and develop Product Owners, translating strategy into clear objectives and allocating capacity to the highest-value work.**  
**• Build strategic, commercial, client and channel depth across the team, strengthening prioritisation, stakeholder management, product discipline and succession capacity.**  
**• Role-model the Bank’s valued behaviours, sound risk judgement, constructive feedback, inclusion, wellbeing and accountability.**  
**Risk, controls and governance**  
**• Embed product, operational, information security, regulatory and conduct requirements throughout discovery, design, delivery, release and post-launch review.**  
**• Ensure material decisions, exceptions, residual risks and control dependencies are appropriately governed and documented.**  
**• Maintain accurate client-facing specifications, user guidance, release notes, testing support and migration plans for new or changed capabilities.**

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Must-have Skills**  
**• Cash and Payments Product Strategy**  
**• Digital Channels and Corporate Connectivity**  
**• Product Commercialisation and Value Proposition**  
**Other Skills**  
**• Portfolio Prioritisation and Investment Discipline**  
**• Client and Market Insight**  
**• Senior Stakeholder Influence**  
**• People Leadership and Product Team Development**

**Motivations**
---------------

* **Shaping client-channel strategy and turning complex Cash and Payments needs into scalable propositions with visible commercial and client value.**

**• Leading across business, product and technology boundaries to resolve competing priorities and deliver high-impact outcomes across markets.**  
**• Building empowered Product Owner teams that combine deep channel expertise with strategic thinking, disciplined execution and strong client focus.**

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Key Experiences**  
**• 15+ years of senior-level experience in Transaction Banking, Cash Management, Payments or enterprise digital channels, including product strategy, proposition development, commercialisation and execution.**  
**• Deep experience in corporate connectivity and more than one client channel, with working knowledge of H2H, SWIFT, APIs and corporate Web banking.**  
**• Strong Cash and Payments domain understanding across domestic and cross-border payments, real-time and bulk payments, payroll, receivables, liquidity, statements and reporting.**  
**• Working command of ISO 20022 payment and reporting messages, legacy MT formats, local clearing formats, and ERP or treasury management system integration.**  
**• Demonstrated experience building business cases, prioritising investments and managing multiple initiatives across countries, products and channels.**  
**• Strong experience in Portfolio management at scale, running a large backlog with many initiatives in parallel, while sharing limited delivery capacity across countries and demand types.**  
**• Proven leadership of Product Owners or Product Managers and senior-level influence across Product, Sales, Technology, Operations, Risk and Compliance.**  
**Certifications / Qualifications (only where mandatory):** **Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in business, finance, engineering, computer science or a related discipline. No role-specific certification is mandatory.**  
**Languages:** **English: professional fluency. Additional languages are advantageous where relevant to the role’s market coverage.**

**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

**We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.**

**Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.**

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation** **, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.**
* **In line with our Fair Pay Charter** **, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.**
* **Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance** **, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.**
* **Time-off** **including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.**
* **Flexible working** **options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.**
* **Proactive wellbeing support** **through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.**
* **A continuous learning culture** **to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.**

**Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.**

author: Hiring Manager
title: Sr. Product Manager, Mobile
job_description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  
  

Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

  
  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  

As the Sr. Product Manager for Mobile you will focus on delivering impactful innovations further accelerating the growth of Docusign's top-rated eSignature mobile apps, which is an important part of our millions of users' journey as we embrace the "anywhere economy". You will drive solutions that allow our customers to get to agreement anywhere on any device. You will work with cross-functional leaders to define a multi-year strategy and lead the efforts to build the roadmap, vision, and priorities for supporting this priority product area. You will deeply understand how Docusign can best deliver for our customers' needs and work with product development teams across Docusign to deliver product capabilities and solutions that support customers end-to-end agreement flows on mobile. Interacting directly with customers to validate needs will be a key part of your role.

Docusign has built award winning and the most pervasive technology for enabling businesses to automate their agreement processes - from generating agreements, negotiating between parties, getting agreements electronically signed, managing the workflows and integrations once an agreement is signed and analyzing and deriving insights from agreements. Today, Docusign's products meet the needs of customers extending from individual consumers to large Enterprises. You will serve as the subject matter expert guiding product development teams on what capabilities and solutions will best meet customers' mobile needs for their agreement challenges. Using qualitative and quantitative insights, you will deliver a strategy and product roadmap that both transforms how Docusign meets customer needs and drives measurable impact. In this position you will work cross-functionally with Design, Marketing, and Engineering and engage directly with customers to experiment and iterate.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the VP, Product Management.

**Responsibility**

* Prioritize opportunities and lead product strategy and roadmaps focused on customer and business impact
* Build roadmaps by synthesizing customer needs, user research, data science, market and competitive insights, marketing input, and field feedback
* Develop a deep understanding of target personas, workflows, pain points, and jobs to be done through customer engagement and lifecycle research-from awareness and evaluation through adoption, renewal, and expansion
* Review competitors, vendors, adjacent solutions, industry trends, and relevant market channels to anticipate customer needs and identify opportunities for differentiation
* Define product vision, requirements, and functional specifications; translate them into developer-ready epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Prioritize and manage the feature backlog, dependencies, and tradeoffs to support effective release and sprint planning
* Lead and motivate a team of engineers and cross-functional representatives toward shared product outcomes
* Partner with Engineering, Design, User Experience, Research, and Program Management to take features from concept through launch while meeting quality, usability, performance, and reliability expectations
* Build business cases and gain stakeholder alignment for new capabilities, investments, and innovations
* Monitor, measure, and report on key business, product, and customer metrics; use telemetry, experimentation, and qualitative and quantitative feedback to drive continuous testing and optimization
* Identify and profile high-value use cases, partners, platforms, APIs, integrations, and ecosystem relationships that can expand product value and adoption
* Collaborate with Marketing, Pricing, Sales, Support, Legal, Security, Compliance, Finance, and Business Development on go-to-market execution, enablement, adoption, and ongoing product growth
* Ensure product decisions account for applicable privacy, security, accessibility, legal, regulatory, and industry requirements
  

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  
  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. **About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Overview:

Visa is seeking an experienced Product Manager to define and drive the strategy, roadmap, and adoption of enterprise Data Governance Platforms. This role will help shape how Visa discovers, understands, governs, measures, and trusts data across the enterprise through capabilities spanning metadata management, data quality, governance workflows, semantic capabilities, domain ownership, and related data governance technologies. The Product Manager will partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Data Governance, Privacy, Security, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable platform capabilities that improve data trust, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and data-driven decision making.

Essential Functions:

* Define vision, strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for one or more enterprise data governance platforms.
* Align platform investments with enterprise data strategy, governance objectives, AI readiness, cloud transformation, and business priorities.
* Manage portfolio priorities, investment tradeoffs, and roadmap sequencing.
* Maintain and prioritize product backlogs, epics, features, and business requirements.
* Partner with engineering teams throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
* Define acceptance criteria and measurable business outcomes.
* Coordinate dependencies across multiple products, teams, and stakeholders.
* Conduct customer discovery and requirements gathering.
* Partner with governance, privacy, risk, architecture, and business teams to identify opportunities and pain points.
* Drive adoption through communication, enablement, onboarding, and feedback programs.
* Translate governance policies and business requirements into scalable platform capabilities.
* Support capabilities including metadata management, data quality, stewardship, governance workflows, access controls, certification, lineage, business definitions, semantic models, and trust indicators.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities for innovation.
* Partner with engineering and architecture teams to define integration strategies across cloud, on-premises, and SaaS environments.
* Collaborate with adjacent platforms supporting analytics, AI/ML, reporting, data engineering, governance, and operational workflows.
* Drive interoperability between governance platforms and enterprise data ecosystems.
* Evaluate commercial, cloud-native, and open-source technologies.
* Conduct product assessments and develop build-versus-buy recommendations.
* Stay current on trends in data governance, metadata management, data quality, AI governance, semantic technologies, and observability.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* 8 or more years of relevant work experience with a bachelor’s degree or at least 5 years of experience with an advanced degree (e.g., Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD

Preferred Qualifications:

* 10 or more years of relevant work experience with a bachelor’s degree, or 7 or more years of experience with an advanced degree (e.g., Master's, MBA, JD, MD), or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD.
* 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Technical Product Management, Platform Product Management, or a related discipline supporting enterprise data, analytics, governance, or technology platforms.
* Experience defining product vision, strategy, roadmaps, and success metrics for enterprise platforms, with a demonstrated ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical constraints.
* Experience working in one or more data management domains, including Data Governance, Metadata Management, Data Quality, Data Catalogs, Data Lineage, Data Stewardship, Master Data Management, Data Observability, Semantic Technologies, or related capabilities.
* Strong understanding of modern data ecosystems, including cloud platforms, data lakes, data warehouses, databases, APIs, data integration patterns, and distributed data architectures.
* Experience partnering closely with engineering, architecture, governance, security, compliance, privacy, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable enterprise solutions.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, influence without authority, build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups, and drive outcomes in complex organizational environments.
* Experience with Agile product development methodologies, including roadmap planning, backlog management, requirements definition, prioritization, and release planning.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate tradeoffs, interpret data, identify opportunities, and make informed product decisions.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and senior leadership.
* Experience evaluating vendor solutions, commercial software products, cloud-native capabilities, and emerging technologies, including development of build-versus-buy recommendations.
* Experience with cloud technologies, enterprise data platforms, databases, SQL, and data engineering concepts.
* Prior experience within financial services, banking, payments, regulated industries, or large enterprise environments is preferred.
* Advanced degrees desirable.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

**About Tekion**  
  
Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform. Our platform spans the Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, the Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises, and the Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform, using cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to bring together vehicle manufacturers, dealerships, and consumers. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia, and Europe.
  
  
**About the Role**
  
  
Tekion connects dealerships - the businesses that sell and service vehicles - with the automakers that build those vehicles, such as General Motors, Honda, or Ford. Across the industry these automakers are referred to as OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers). The software on each side needs to exchange information automatically and reliably: vehicle orders, inventory, repair records, customer details, and much more. The software that makes this exchange happen is called integration. We are seeking a driven, technically curious Product Manager I to join our Integrations team. You will take ownership of one integration pattern - a family of similar integrations that share the same shape (for example, all the integrations that send vehicle service and repair data to automakers). Your mission is to make every integration in that family measurably healthy and best-in-class, shift more of its delivery from manual building to AI-assisted building, and make sure dealerships actually adopt and benefit from it. This is a hands-on role for an early-career product manager who is comfortable with technical concepts, motivated by measurable outcomes, and excited to help modernize how a decades-old industry connects its software. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, and senior product managers, who will guide and mentor you as you grow into full ownership of your integration pattern.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
  
  

* Keep your integrations healthy and best-in-class: Define what “good” looks like for your integration pattern, measure it in our Integration Platform (Tekion’s internal health-monitoring system), and drive coverage, reliability, and quality up across all your integrations - benchmarking each against the best competing product in the market.

  

* Win on AI-powered delivery: Shift your pattern from hand-built integrations toward ones generated with Tekion’s AI-assisted build tools (internally, APC Studio), help sharpen the AI tools you depend on, and own a complete, living set of requirements that any engineering team can build from.

  

* Drive revenue through OEM certifications: Lead integration patterns toward successful OEM certification so OEM-approved integrations can be adopted by dealers at scale. Drive adoption and reduce support load: Make your integrations easy to install and switch on, raise dealership uptake where it is low, and reduce support tickets by tracking and fixing root causes.

  

* Partner across teams: Translate the needs of dealers, automakers, and partners into clear requirements, and work day-to-day with Engineering, Design, Support, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver, launch, and measure impact.

  
**What We’re Looking For**
  
  

* Around 3+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in a technical product, integration, API, or platform role. Strong early-career candidates with a technical background are encouraged to apply.

  

* Exposure to integrations, APIs, or platform and marketplace products, with the ability to read technical documentation and discuss APIs, webhooks, and data flows with engineers. (An API is a defined way for two systems to exchange data; a webhook is an automatic notification one system sends another when something happens. You do not need to write code.)

  

* A strong bias toward measurable outcomes, with comfort using dashboards, metrics, and data to set targets and track progress.

  
• Clear writing skills - the ability to turn messy, ambiguous requirements into crisp specifications and user stories. • Curiosity about AI and how it can automate technical work, plus the drive to improve the tools you use.
  
  

* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  

* The ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and make thoughtful trade-offs in a fast-paced environment.

  

* A bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Nice to Have**
  
  

* Interest in or exposure to AI agents, large language models (LLMs), and automated workflows.

  

* Familiarity with the automotive retail world - dealerships, the Dealer Management System (DMS, the core software a dealership runs its business on), or automaker (OEM) certification programs.

  
**Why Join Us**  
  

* Modernize an industry: Help modernize how an entire industry connects its software, moving from slow, hand-built integrations to a fast, AI-powered delivery model.

  

* Work at the frontier of AI delivery: Be hands-on with how AI is used to scope, build, and test real enterprise integrations.

  

* See measurable impact: Own clear, measurable goals and watch your work show up directly in integration health, adoption, and support metrics.

  

* Grow with mentorship: Learn from senior product managers and engineers, with a clear path to grow into broader ownership.

  
Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

**Current Tekion Employees: Please apply via the Internal Job Board in Ashby.**

Note: Tekion recently transitioned to a new recruiting tool and we appreciate your patience and feedback as we adjust to our new system!

Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, victim of violence or having a family member who is a victim of violence, the intersectionality of two or more protected categories, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

For more information on our privacy practices, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice

***Important****: Tekion will only contact candidates from an @**tekion.com* *email address or through our applicant tracking system (no-reply@ashbyhq.com). We may also work with authorized recruiting partners from time to time. Tekion and its recruiting partners will never ask you to pay fees or send money for applications, interviews, training, or onboarding. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, please do not respond or share personal or financial information.*

* Win on AI-powered delivery: Shift your pattern from hand-built integrations toward ones generated with Tekion’s AI-assisted build tools (internally, APC Studio), help sharpen the AI tools you depend on, and own a complete, living set of requirements that any engineering team can build from.

  

* Drive revenue through OEM certifications: Lead integration patterns toward successful OEM certification so OEM-approved integrations can be adopted by dealers at scale. Drive adoption and reduce support load: Make your integrations easy to install and switch on, raise dealership uptake where it is low, and reduce support tickets by tracking and fixing root causes.

  

* Partner across teams: Translate the needs of dealers, automakers, and partners into clear requirements, and work day-to-day with Engineering, Design, Support, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver, launch, and measure impact.

  
**What We’re Looking For**
  
  

* Around 3+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in a technical product, integration, API, or platform role. Strong early-career candidates with a technical background are encouraged to apply.

  

* Exposure to integrations, APIs, or platform and marketplace products, with the ability to read technical documentation and discuss APIs, webhooks, and data flows with engineers. (An API is a defined way for two systems to exchange data; a webhook is an automatic notification one system sends another when something happens. You do not need to write code.)

  

* A strong bias toward measurable outcomes, with comfort using dashboards, metrics, and data to set targets and track progress.

  
• Clear writing skills - the ability to turn messy, ambiguous requirements into crisp specifications and user stories. • Curiosity about AI and how it can automate technical work, plus the drive to improve the tools you use.
  
  

* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  

* The ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and make thoughtful trade-offs in a fast-paced environment.

  

* A bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Nice to Have**
  
  

* Interest in or exposure to AI agents, large language models (LLMs), and automated workflows.

  

* Familiarity with the automotive retail world - dealerships, the Dealer Management System (DMS, the core software a dealership runs its business on), or automaker (OEM) certification programs.

  
**Why Join Us**  
  

* Modernize an industry: Help modernize how an entire industry connects its software, moving from slow, hand-built integrations to a fast, AI-powered delivery model.

  

* Work at the frontier of AI delivery: Be hands-on with how AI is used to scope, build, and test real enterprise integrations.

  

* See measurable impact: Own clear, measurable goals and watch your work show up directly in integration health, adoption, and support metrics.

  

* Grow with mentorship: Learn from senior product managers and engineers, with a clear path to grow into broader ownership.

### **Why Work at Lenovo**

We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.

  
  

Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).

  

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.

### **Description and Requirements**

**Product Strategy & Vision**

* Define and own the global product vision and strategy for Offer-to-Glass.
* Translate Digital Commerce strategy and OGSM priorities into an outcome-based product roadmap.
* Establish a clear definition of what constitutes a complete, accurate, sellable, and customer-ready offer.
* Balance near-term commercial requirements with global scalability, simplification, automation, and longer-term platform capabilities.

**Offer Readiness & Digital Shelf**

* Own the product capabilities required to move approved offers onto the digital shelf.
* Ensure product information, attributes, taxonomy, digital assets, localized content, pricing, promotions, and availability information can be accurately represented in the customer experience.
* Identify breakdowns between source systems and what customers ultimately see on Lenovo.com.
* Establish monitoring and measures that assess the actual customer-facing offer rather than relying solely on upstream system status.

**Roadmap, Prioritization & Investment**

* Maintain a single, prioritized roadmap and backlog for Offer-to-Glass.
* Bring Geo and business-unit demand into the product model rather than managing requests as disconnected local projects.
* Prioritize according to customer value, business impact, strategic alignment, evidence, dependencies, risk, and effort.
* Make clear trade-offs when demand exceeds available capacity or funding.

**Product Discovery**

* Lead continuous discovery to understand why products and offers become delayed, incomplete, inaccurate, incorrectly priced, unavailable, or otherwise unsellable.
* Use customer research, analytics, operational data, business feedback, and experimentation to validate problems before committing significant investment.
* Define problem statements, hypotheses, expected outcomes, and success measures before moving into delivery.

**Delivery, Launch & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain product accountability from discovery through delivery, launch, adoption, measurement, and improvement.
* Partner with Technology and Engineering on scope, sequencing, release, and technical dependencies while retaining accountability for the product outcome.
* Ensure capabilities are adopted across markets and transition appropriate steady-state processes to operational teams.
* Monitor production performance and place corrective work back into the roadmap when offers are wrong, missing, or unsellable.

**Global & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Align Digital Commerce, Geo commerce teams, merchandising, pricing, Product, Design, Technology, Engineering, Analytics, Operations, and business units around shared outcomes.
* Establish clear decision rights and handoffs with adjacent product domains.
* Communicate strategy, priorities, investment needs, progress, risks, decisions, and outcomes to senior leadership.
* Lead through influence within a global, highly matrixed organization.

The Senior Product Manager should establish baselines and targets covering:

* Accuracy of products, prices, promotions, and offer information on Lenovo.com
* Percentage of intended assortment that is live and sellable
* Time from approved offer or price change to customer visibility
* Product/content/data completeness
* Accuracy of availability and delivery signals
* Reduction in offers that are missing, incorrect, or unsellable
* Production regressions affecting live offers
* Time to detect and resolve offer-related issues
* Global adoption of capabilities versus market-specific duplication
* Commercial impact attributable to improved offer readiness and merchandising capabilities

**Additional Locations**:

* India - Karnātaka - Bangalore

* India - Karnātaka - BANGALORE

* India

* India - Karnātaka

\* India - Karnātaka - Bangalore , \* India - Karnātaka - BANGALORE

**NOTICE FOR PUBLIC**

  

At Lenovo, we follow strict policies and legal compliance for our recruitment process, which includes role alignment, employment terms discussion, final selection and offer approval, and recording transactions in our internal system. Interviews may be conducted via audio, video, or in-person depending on the role, and you will always meet with an official Lenovo representative.

Please beware of fraudulent recruiters posing as Lenovo representatives. They may request cash deposits or personal information. Always apply through official Lenovo channels and never share sensitive information. Lenovo does not solicit money or sensitive information from applicants and will not request payments for training or equipment.

Kindly verify job offers through the official Lenovo careers page or contact IndiaTA@lenovo.com. Stay informed and cautious to protect yourself from recruitment fraud. Report any suspicious activity to local authorities.
